Śauca (‘descendant of Śuci’) is the patronymic of a man,
called also Āhneya, who is mentioned as a teacher in the
Taittirīya Āraṇyaka (ii. 12).

Śaucad-ratha (‘descendant of Śucad-ratha’) is the patro-
nymic of Sunītha in the Rigveda (v. 79, 2).

Śauceya (‘descendant of Śuci’) Prācīnayogya (‘descendant
of Prācīnayoga’) is the name of a teacher in the Śatapatha
Brāhmaṇa (xi. 5, 3, 1. 8). Śauceya is also the patronymic of
Sārvaseni in the Taittirīya Saṃhitā (vii. 1, 10, 2).
